tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.56; also called Jaala at Neh.7.58;
§ Jaala or Jaalah = "ascending"
the head of a family of the descendants of Solomon's slaves who returned from exile with Zerubbabel

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Jaala or Jaalah, one of the Nethinim
strongs_1890.derivation: or יַעֲלָה; the same as H3280 (יַעֲלָה) or direct from H3276 (יַעַל);
